journeys.intro: Learn by doing — each journey walks you through one real process, step by step. Finishing one goes on your profile.
journeys.about_before: A journey is a guided arc over the real institutions — you mark off each step as you take it, and completing the whole arc earns a medal on
journeys.about_after: . A medal never changes a vote, a seat, or what you are allowed to do.

message_new.title: New message
message_new.intro: Message one person directly, or start a group with a few. Either way it is just a conversation — talk, files, voice, and video.
message_new.name_hint: A friendly label so you can find it later — direct or group, one field starts it.
message_new.name_placeholder: e.g. Saturday crew — or a friend’s name for a direct message
message_new.note_link_title: You add people with a link, not by searching for them.
message_new.note_link_body: Names here are pseudonymous and there is no directory to look anyone up in — so once the conversation exists, you share a private invite link and whoever opens it lands inside. Nobody can be added without a link they chose to open.
message_new.note_temp_title: A group message is temporary and private.
